3. **lighthouse-core/computed/resource-summary.js**: This file likely computes the resources and their importance for preconnect suggestions. Miscomputations here might cause incorrect or redundant suggestions. 

These files are crucial to investigate because they directly involve gathering link elements and performing audits related to preconnects.
